name: Stephen Cragg
bio: Stephen Cragg is an American television producer and director. Cragg has directed for several present-day network television series. Cragg has directed episodes of Desperate Housewives, Boston Legal, and Third Watch. Craig was also a producer on MDs, Doogie Howser, M.D., The American Embassy, and The Byrds of Paradise.
